title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: In logistic regression, the probability $$\$P(Y=1|X)\$$$ is modeled using the logistic function, which is a type of sigmoid function. This function maps any real-valued number into the $$(0,1)$$ interval, making it suitable for binary classification.

title: Comparing Probabilities and Linear Combinations
text: Consider the logistic function $\sigma(X**T\beta)$, which outputs a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$. Compare this with the linear combination $X**T\beta$, which can take any real value. Think about how these two expressions relate to each other in terms of their range and behavior.
